lanes.summary: The diff fails to meet several acceptance criteria and introduces changes not requested in the ticket. It updates `Cargo.lock` dependencies, alters the coverage schedule, adds an unrequested standalone runner guard workflow, applies an incorrect runs-on label to `kani-gate`, and lacks any mechanism to enforce the 'Operator OK' requirement for workflow edits.

findings.claim: The diff modifies Cargo.lock by bumping dependencies (e.g., rand from 0.8.5 to 0.8.8) and adding new ones, which the ticket does not ask for.
findings.fix: Revert the changes to Cargo.lock, or create a separate ticket for dependency updates.

findings.claim: The ticket does not ask to change the execution schedule for coverage. The diff deletes the weekly cron job entirely and adds a tag-based trigger in ci.yml instead.
findings.fix: Maintain the weekly cron schedule for coverage, migrating its job to the self-hosted pool as requested.

findings.claim: The acceptance criteria requires moving jobs exactly to `[self-hosted, Linux, clean-room]`. The `kani-gate` job adds the `X64` label, violating the requested pool specification.
findings.fix: Change the runs-on label for kani-gate to strictly match `[self-hosted, Linux, clean-room]`.

findings.claim: The ticket requests a shrink-only hosted-runner guard 'inside gate', but the diff additionally creates a standalone workflow file for it, which was not asked for.
findings.fix: Delete the standalone `.github/workflows/runner-guard.yml` workflow, as the guard is already properly implemented inside the gate job.

findings.claim: The acceptance criteria states 'Operator OK required for workflow edits', but the diff provides no mechanism (such as a .github/CODEOWNERS addition) to enforce this requirement.
findings.fix: Add a .github/CODEOWNERS entry (or similar mechanism) requiring operator approval for edits to .github/workflows/**.

lanes.summary: Verdict: FAIL. While the diff successfully migrates all 12 GitHub-hosted jobs to the self-hosted clean-room pool and establishes the ratchet check, the submission is refuted on multiple grounds: (1) scripts/check_no_hosted_runners.sh violates the mandatory CI anti-vacuity policy by exiting 0 with PASS when zero workflow files are found; (2) Cargo.lock was modified with unrequested dependency upgrades not specified in ticket PMAT-441; (3) deny.toml was manually modified despite an explicit header prohibition ('Deployed from paiml/infra — do not edit manually') to ignore two security advisories, weakening the security gate; and (4) delegating clippy to sovereign-ci weakens the lint gate by injecting '-A unused-variables' and allowing a fallback to default features.

findings.claim: `scripts/check_no_hosted_runners.sh` violates the anti-vacuity rule for CI verification scripts: when run against an empty directory or when zero workflow files are found, it outputs `PASS 0 hosted job(s) remain, all in the shrinking baseline` and exits with code 0 instead of failing.
findings.fix: Enforce anti-vacuity by asserting that at least one `.yml`/`.yaml` workflow file was scanned before reporting success.

findings.claim: The diff modifies `Cargo.lock` (updating rand, fastrand, h2, crossbeam-epoch, quinn-proto, memmap2, rustls, and adding chacha20, rand_core, rand_pcg) which was not requested or described in ticket PMAT-441 (scope creep).
findings.fix: Revert Cargo.lock modifications or separate dependency updates into their own dedicated tracking issue (#434).

findings.claim: `deny.toml` is marked `# Deployed from paiml/infra — do not edit manually.`. Modifying it directly in this repo violates that deployment contract and weakens the supply-chain security gate by ignoring two unmaintained advisories (RUSTSEC-2024-0370 and RUSTSEC-2026-0173).
findings.fix: Revert manual edits to deny.toml and update the upstream source in paiml/infra, or resolve the underlying outdated dependencies.

findings.claim: Replacing the local clippy check (`cargo clippy --lib --tests --all-features -- -D warnings`) with `sovereign-ci.yml` weakens the lint gate: sovereign-ci unconditionally adds `-A unused-variables` (masking warnings previously rejected by -D warnings) and falls back to running `cargo clippy -p <repo>` with default features if the full workspace clippy check fails.
findings.fix: Preserve strict clippy enforcement with `-D warnings` without suppressing unused-variables or falling back to default features.

lanes.summary: The diff fails review against PMAT-441. It introduces out-of-scope dependency modifications in Cargo.lock and advisory suppressions in deny.toml, weakens the CI test gate by omitting library unit tests (--lib) in test_args, deletes the scheduled weekly coverage workflow rather than migrating its runner, creates an unrequested standalone runner-guard workflow, and deviates from runner label specifications in kani-gate.

findings.claim: The diff modifies Cargo.lock by upgrading, downgrading, and adding multiple dependencies (e.g. rand, rustls, windows-sys, crossbeam-epoch, fastrand, h2, memmap2, quinn-proto, chacha20), which is out of scope and not requested by ticket PMAT-441.
findings.fix: Revert all Cargo.lock changes to keep the PR scoped strictly to the CI runner migration.

findings.claim: The diff adds security advisory ignores in deny.toml for RUSTSEC-2024-0370 and RUSTSEC-2026-0173, weakening security auditing gates without authorization from ticket PMAT-441.
findings.fix: Remove the advisory ignore entries from deny.toml and resolve dependency vulnerabilities via separate dedicated dependency upgrade tickets.

findings.claim: In .github/workflows/ci.yml, test_args is set to '--tests --all-features', dropping '--lib' from the previous test suite execution ('cargo test --lib --tests --all-features'). This weakens the test gate by omitting all library unit tests.
findings.fix: Change test_args to '--lib --tests --all-features' in the sovereign-ci workflow call.

findings.claim: The diff completely deletes .github/workflows/coverage.yml and removes the weekly scheduled coverage run rather than migrating its runner to the self-hosted clean-room pool as requested by the ticket.
findings.fix: Restore the scheduled coverage workflow and migrate its runner configuration to [self-hosted, Linux, clean-room].

findings.claim: The diff introduces a new standalone workflow .github/workflows/runner-guard.yml, whereas the ticket acceptance criteria specifies a shrink-only hosted-runner guard inside gate.
findings.fix: Remove .github/workflows/runner-guard.yml since the ratchet check is already executed inside the gate job in ci.yml.

findings.claim: The kani-gate job specifies runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clean-room], adding the extra X64 label contrary to the acceptance criteria requirement to move all jobs to [self-hosted, Linux, clean-room].
findings.fix: Update kani-gate runs-on labels to match [self-hosted, Linux, clean-room] or update ticket acceptance criteria.
